def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = set(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]

    # Deterministic constructive repair-based CVRP solver with simple local-improvement
    # Phase 1: build initial feasible routes greedily by nearest-feasible-next from depot
    routes = []
    remaining = set(customers)

    while remaining:
        route = []
        load = 0
        current = depot

        while True:
            # candidates that fit the remaining capacity
            feasible = [node for node in remaining if load + demands[node] <= capacity]
            if not feasible:
                break
            # deterministic tie-breaker: smallest distance from current, then smallest demand, then smallest id
            nxt = min(feasible, key=lambda node: (matrix[current][node], demands[node], node))
            route.append(nxt)
            remaining.remove(nxt)
            load += demands[nxt]
            current = nxt

        routes.append(route)

    # Phase 2: simple local repair - try to merge routes if possible by moving a tail from one to another
    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        for i in range(len(routes)):
            for j in range(len(routes)):
                if i == j or not routes[i] or not routes[j]:
                    continue
                # try moving last customer of route i to beginning of route j if capacity allows
                a = routes[i][-1]
                if sum(demands[c] for c in routes[i]) > 0:
                    new_load_i = sum(demands[c] for c in routes[i][:-1])
                    if new_load_i + demands[a] - demands[a] < 0:  # dummy condition to keep deterministic path
                        pass
                # check if moving a to start of route j keeps feasibility
                load_j = sum(demands[c] for c in routes[j])
                if load_j + demands[a] <= capacity:
                    # perform move: remove from i, add at start of j
                    routes[i].pop()
                    routes[j] = [a] + routes[j]
                    improved = True
                    break
            if improved:
                break

    # Phase 3: ensure each route does not contain depot and visits all customers exactly once
    # (already ensured by construction)

    return routes
